source.publication: 2025 Expanded Instructions (IA 1040) and the 2025 IA 1040 Iowa Individual Income Tax Return
source.section: IA 1040 form PDF p.1 Step 3 lines a, b, d; form PDF p.2 lines 1c, 2-5, 7, 8, 11, 12; Instructions PDF p.8 Step 3; PDF p.9-10 lines 2-4; PDF p.12 line 5 ('Iowa now has a flat tax rate of 3.8%'); PDF p.18 line 12; Schedule 1 line 7, PDF p.67-68 and form PDF p.5; Retirement Income Tax Guidance, 'Who qualifies'

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = private pension (you) 50,000.00 = 50,000.00. Federal taxable income = 50,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 for 65 or older = 32,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IA 1040 filing status 1 (single). Step 3 line a personal credits 1 x 40.00 = 40.00; line b 1 x 20.00 = 20.00 (65 or older on or before January 1, 2026; nobody blind); line c no dependents; line d and line 8 = 60.00. Line 1c federal AGI 50,000.00; line 2 federal taxable income 32,250.00. Schedule 1 line 7 column B: pension 50,000.00 of you (age 67, 55 or older on December 31, 2025) excluded; line 7 total 50,000.00. Schedule 1 line 21 net modifications = -50,000.00; line 3 = -50,000.00. Line 4 Iowa taxable income = 32,250.00 + (-50,000.00) = -17,750.00 on the form (a negative figure is allowed there); floored at 0.00 in expected. Line 5 tax = 3.8% x 0.00 = 0.00; line 7 = 0.00. Line 11 total credits 60.00; line 12 = 0.00 - 60.00, below zero, so enter 0.00 (non-refundable; expected credits shows the 0.00 used). State income tax 0.00 (no line 13-17 credits; line 19 school district or EMS surtax is local, not computed). The form allows whole-dollar rounding; expected keeps the cents. Low-income exemption test (PDF p.10-11): line 4 -17,750.00 + federal deduction 17,750.00 = 0.00, against 24,000.00: exempt on the form. Single filers' tax reduction (PDF p.18): its worksheet 41-146 is not in the sources, so it is not applied. Line 7 subtracts the whole pension from a federal taxable income already reduced by the federal deduction, so line 4 goes negative. The tax and credits are 0.00; the form exempts this filer too.
accepted_approximations: The low-income exemption, the alternate tax (every status except single) and the single filers' tax reduction are not applied; the record holds them in notes. The reduction's terms are not in the sources.
School district and county EMS surtaxes (a percentage of the tax, form line 19) are local and out of scope (issue #1).
